# Deck

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

The map: layers bottom to top, the basemap, and the camera. Camera fields are props, so a keyframed fly-through costs no queries.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "deck", "name": "deck", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

An edge into it ends at `"targetPort": "layers"`; a parameter is set in `params` (leave out the ones at their default), driven by an edge to `par:longitude`, or read elsewhere as `ch('deck/longitude')`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Remarks

Deck is the map: what it draws, the basemap under it, the camera and the export settings. The editor shows the first Deck in the document that is not bypassed.

Layers wire into `layers`, each edge with an `index`; deck.gl draws them in that order, so the highest index draws on top. Basemap picks a CARTO style, or `none` for layers with no map under them. A Map style URL, or a [Map Style](./map-style.md) node wired to `par:mapStyle`, wins over Basemap.

The camera is the Longitude, Latitude, Zoom, Pitch and Bearing parameters. They are deck props, so keyframing them for a fly-through costs no queries, and dragging the map with the Deck selected writes them, as keys when they are keyframed. A [View State](./view-state.md) or [Fit Bounds](./fit-bounds.md) wired to `viewState` replaces them.

The Export folder sets the render: its Width and Height, the level of detail, and the codec and frame rate of a video.

## Examples

The smallest map: one layer over the Positron basemap, framed on San Francisco.

```json
{
  "nodes": [
    { "id": "n1", "op": "scatter", "name": "points", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": { "position": "[lng, lat]" } },
    { "id": "n2", "op": "deck", "name": "deck", "x": 300, "y": 0, "params": { "basemap": "positron", "longitude": -122.42, "latitude": 37.77, "zoom": 11 } }
  ],
  "edges": [{ "id": "e1", "source": "n1", "sourcePort": "out", "target": "n2", "targetPort": "layers", "index": 0 }]
}
```

## Older projects

Projects saved before documents used operator classes. These convert to `deck` when they open: `BlendingOp`, `DeckRendererOp`, `MaplibreBasemapOp`, `OutOp`.
